last_batch.research: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 and PubMed E-utils were queried for all 30 topics with exact intervention-name checks on returned records. New evidence used PMIDs 31562796, 34102137, 27979383, 32534646, 31122901, 38319896, 28885881, 39098455, 28276859, 33476593, 33001135, 29151359, 37937763, 27959700, 32786187, 34606378, 36511784, 32731259, 34310172, 30098165, 27824902, 36764316, 40783289, and 39167807, with duplicate source PMIDs reused for closely related worklist topics where the same verified comparison applied. Each new entry has a numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect, Korean subjects, and a mapped prescription-drug category. Three topics were rejected because the verified evidence was single-arm without a valid comparator effect: atezolizumab Rare Tumor, zanubrutinib Marginal Zone Lymphoma, and belzutifan Pheochromocytoma.
